description: AKAC 0.6 knowledge semantics vectors (ADR-022, spec/AKAC-0.6.md). Synthetic data. kind 'decision': decide() over kbFixture(clock) with patches; kind 'steps': gateway operations through the engine in order (session-scoped records in its in-memory partition); every step states its expected effect and audited code, a derive step optionally fields of the stored record. The last step decides the vector's outcome. Patches are whole records ([collection, id, record]); settings and combinationRules start empty. Depth (K-D*, R182), modality (K-M*, R183), tags and combination (K-T*, K-C*, R186, R188), residency (K-R*, R187), session scope (K-E*, R190), model lineage (K-L*, R191), placement (K-W*, R192) and provenance cycles (K-Y*, R185).
